summary: Turn AI requirements into risk, policy and vendor-review workflows. Explore practical AI compliance training and plan your team’s next steps.
lede: AI compliance implementation helps compliance, legal, privacy, product and procurement teams turn AI oversight requirements into repeatable workflows. Participants learn to scope and inventory systems, assess and classify risks, map policies to controls, and record decisions and evidence. They also practise supplier due diligence and designing monitoring and audit checks using structured registers and practical scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, review or document AI use in products, operations and procurement. It suits people who need to turn internal requirements into workable controls, with familiarity in their own organization’s compliance, technology or purchasing processes.
modules: NIST AI RMF Scope and Inventory
NIST AI RMF Monitoring and Audit
prerequisites: Prior experience in at least one of compliance, legal, privacy, procurement, internal audit, information security or AI product governance is recommended. No coding or model-building is required. Familiarity with your organization’s policy approval and procurement processes will help you apply the exercises.
